lines.text: Lead dhoondhna, email, LinkedIn message, call… yeh sab ek system karta hai. Main nahi.
9 workflows hain. Dikhata hoon kaise jude hain.
Pehla, sahi target companies ki list khud banti hai.
Phir har lead ke liye personalized email sequence. Template wala “Dear Sir” nahi.
Uske baad LinkedIn pe connection aur message. Khud se.
Aur calls? AI voice agent khud karta hai.
Phir har lead ka update ek CRM mein. Ek dashboard pe dikhta hai kaun kahan hai.
Ab honest baat. Yeh “set and forget” nahi hai.
Galat list daali? Toh 9 workflows milke galat logon ko spam karenge. Bas tezi se.
System speed deta hai. Sahi target aapko hi chunna padega.
Aapki sales team ko bhi aisa chahiye? DM karo “LEADS”.
